record.rationale: DOM scroll track projection over actual ScViewData and compressed sheet dimensions.
responsibilities: Restores the unsplit first visible cell exactly using an integer scroll offset and publishes actual scroll movement into the current sheet view.
Maps frozen geometry to bounded moving scroll domains using native dimensions and the source split margin. Updates only the available movable axes.
Restores and scrolls both normal pane pairs independently, using the source splitter margin and retaining exact logical wheel deltas across the integer browser tracks.

stackDivergence.rationale: The browser virtualizes a bounded DOM scroll track and converts physical offsets to native logical origins.
